notes.title: Update : FOV Slider, Camera Shake Fix, Bug Fixes & More!
notes.notes:
This update brings a lot of changes and fixes inspired by the feedback from players. Thank you so much for all your comments, they really help me improve the game!

Here’s what’s new:

Significantly reduced camera shake

Added FOV slider

Fixed bug where all ammo was lost after loading from death

Removed forced stealth sections (except for the boss fight, where it’s part of the story)

Thanks again to everyone who gave feedback.

notes.title: Ammo Balancing, Performance Improvements, Shadow Fixes & More
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Over the past few updates, I’ve made a number of improvements to the game:[/p][p]_Ammo balancing : increased ammo availability based on player feedback[/p][p]_Performance improvements : better framerate in certain areas[/p][p]_Shadow rendering fixes : reduced visual artifacts and glitches[/p][p]_Other small adjustments and optimizations[/p][p]Thanks again for all your support and feedback.[/p][p]— Meddy[/p]

notes.title: Performance Optimization Update
notes.notes: This update brings some performance optimizations to help improve framerate in certain areas, overall performance should now feel smoother.

notes.title: Update: Shadow Fix, Ammo Balancing & More
notes.notes: This update addresses shadow rendering issues, improves ammo balance, and includes various other small fixes and improvements.
